expectation: Cytoplasmic stain filling whole cell bodies and processes of macrophages, microglia, monocytes and dendritic cells. Scattered stellate cells, moderately common, in the lamina propria and stroma. Absent from epithelium and lumen. CD163+ cells should be a subset.
observed: A: yellow in the villus cores and lamina propria, not in the epithelial nuclear rim or lumen. B and C: sparse, with clusters only in stroma and almost nothing in epithelium or lumen. D: stellate cells with processes. E: dense branched IBA1 cells, with CD163 overlapping a subset and many IBA1-only cells.
why: IBA1 marks discrete stellate cells in the stromal compartment, absent from epithelium and lumen, and overlapping a subset with CD163 as the marker graph predicts.
